title: Permanent WMI Event Subscription Component Created
detection_hypothesis: If WMI is used for persistence, a filter, consumer, or binding creation record will appear in the subscription telemetry.

field_semantics.EventType: Sub-type of the telemetry record, such as SetValue or WmiBindingEvent.
field_semantics.Operation: Lifecycle operation applied to the subscription component.

collection_prerequisites: WMI subscription auditing is enabled (Sysmon Event IDs 19, 20 and 21).
The agent configuration does not exclude WMI activity generated by management tools.
expected_collection_gaps: Subscriptions created before agent deployment are not observed.
Remote subscription creation may be attributed to the target host only.
normalization_assumptions: EventType distinguishes filter, consumer, and binding records.
Operation is either Created or Deleted.
ingestion_differences: Field names differ between Sysmon and WMI-Activity operational logs.
Query text may be truncated by some pipelines.
retention_considerations: WMI subscription telemetry is low volume and inexpensive to retain for a year.
expected_volume: Very low outside management server builds.
false_positive_strategy: Benign subscriptions come from a small, stable set of management products and use recognisable filter names. Tune on the Name and Consumer values, and keep the creation operation itself unfiltered.
tuning_guidance: Exclude specific management subscription names on the hosts where that product is installed. Broad exclusion of the binding event type removes the highest-value record in this family.
test_strategy: Positive cases create a filter and a binding. Negative cases cover deletion, a non-subscription event type, and a query-only record.

attack_techniques.name: Event Triggered Execution: Windows Management Instrumentation Event Subscription

author: Salvatore Mazzaglia
